defect: The new GetOldestSave starts idxTime at 0 and keeps entries with a smaller time, so it can only pick entries whose mktime is negative or -1, i.e. empty save slots, never the oldest real save.
reason: The fix skips empty entries and makes the comparisons signed in GetOldestSave, a function this change added; the GetLatestSave comparison existed before but the oldest-save logic is new here.

defect: The fix renames the unused Event::PRESENT_REQUESTED to PRESENTED and makes the D3D11 backend clear its cached render target views on present.
reason: The real defect (over-eager elimination of render target binds) lies in thin3d_d3d11.cpp caching, not in the enum this header change added.

defect: The in-game check is inverted: DEBUG_STATS and FRAME_GRAPH are drawn only when not in game, the opposite of the commit's intent.
reason: The fix flips exactly the two !inGame conditions this change added.

defect: The fix opens the chat window on key up instead of key down, because the control mapper never sees the up event once the dialog takes input.
reason: The chat key already fired on down before this change, and at this commit ControlMapper passed down/up straight through with no edge tracking; the stuck-key behaviour comes from the later ControlMapper state-tracking refactor.

defect: The #ifdef GOLD branches are swapped, so Gold builds are titled "PPSSPP" and normal builds "PPSSPP Gold".
reason: The fix swaps exactly the two name strings this change added.

defect: The change caps the framebuffer size by the scissor rectangle; the fix drops both this cap and the region-based sizing of the previous commit and returns to a viewport heuristic.
reason: The fix reverts this change together with the preceding region-sizing commit and redesigns the heuristic, so it cannot be told whether the misalignment came from the scissor cap or from the region sizing.

defect: vrexp2 computes 1/exp(s*log2(e)) instead of 1/2^s; the fix uses 1/powf(2, s).
reason: The same wrong formula was already in the wired-up Int_VRexp2 before this change, which only moved it into Int_VV2Op; the other fix hunks touch code this change did not write.

defect: The DXT1/3/5 entries of the bufw alignment mask down-align DXT buffer widths as if they were linear formats; the fix uses a plain 0x7FF mask for them.
reason: The identical DXT alignment was introduced two hours earlier in GLES TextureCache by 8ca31f7 and this change only moved it into the shared header (also applying it to DX9 and softgpu).

defect: The fix removes the Core_Resume() call after a dropped file is booted, which crashed.
reason: Core_Resume here is a mechanical rename of Core_EnableStepping(false); the crash comes from later changes that made Core_Resume dereference currentMIPS->pc.

defect: The fix reworks auto-boot (getFileInfo instead of File::Exists, always start at LogoScreen) and folds the platform #else branch away.
reason: The #else LogoScreen line this change added is correct; the auto-boot problems were in pre-existing code.

defect: The %08x bounds check uses i + 3 >= n, rejecting a format string that ends in %08x.
reason: The fix changes exactly this off-by-one comparison in the parser this change added.

defect: Dropping the KEY_DOWN check lets KEY_CHAR events through the key-mapping lookup, so a typed 'o' whose char code equals the Esc keycode maps to VIRTKEY_PAUSE (also added here) and is eaten.
reason: The fix restores a KEY_UP|KEY_DOWN filter on the condition this change loosened.

defect: The fix stops VKRGraphicsPipeline::Create from deleting desc at all, since desc became shared and Create runs once per render pass type.
reason: Keeping desc in debug builds is freed by the destructor; the need to keep desc came from the later per-render-pass-type pipeline refactor, not from this change.

defect: The fix removes the release-build delete of desc in VKRGraphicsPipeline::Create and marks desc as not owned in the header.
reason: The header lines this change wrote (non-owning desc, empty destructor) are correct; the offending delete in Create predates it and was already wrong once Create ran per render pass type and thin3d passed an embedded desc (80ca822), and in this header the fix only adds a "not owned!" comment.

defect: The fix makes ShowRegionOnGameIcon (and related game-list settings) global instead of per-game and marks the right-analog settings per-game.
reason: This is a per-game configuration-flag cleanup, not the repair of a wrong result, crash or broken interface.

defect: The fix latches bBufferedRendering once per frame, notifies the texture cache on every decimated framebuffer, and clears all texture entries that point at a destroyed framebuffer.
reason: The crashes come from pre-existing code (the decimation notify only when fbo is set, the single-entry NotifyFramebufferDestroyed, direct mid-frame config reads that already existed in the create path), not from the toggle handling this change added.

defect: The fix makes NotifyFramebufferDestroyed clear every cache entry pointing at the destroyed framebuffer and handles non-buffered framebuffers in SetTexture.
reason: At this commit no virtual framebuffers existed in non-buffered mode and every decimated framebuffer was notified; the dangling pointers come from later framebuffer changes, and the single-entry clearing mirrors the pre-existing FBO* design.

defect: ApplySamplingParams builds a 3-bit mip key with the mag filter bit and uses it to index the 2-entry MagFiltGL array (out of bounds) while passing a plain linear/nearest as the min filter, swapping min and mag handling.
reason: The fix rewrites exactly this line to index MinFiltGL with the min key and pass the mag filter directly.

defect: The change garbled an error log text to "Could not file"; the fix makes it "Could not read file".
reason: The only repair is the wording of a log message, which is cosmetic and changes no behaviour.

defect: The fix merges SwitchToWindowed/SwitchToFullscreen into one ToggleFullscreen and changes the startup path that intermediate commits had reordered.
reason: The code the fix replaces (ShowWindow SW_MAXIMIZE/SW_RESTORE, fullscreen before ShowWindow at startup) came from later commits be223d4 and cf00fd1; no defect in the lines this change wrote is identified.

defect: The new FakeSysCalls entry for HLEReturnFromMipsCall has no argmask, and hleDoLogInternal calls strlen on the argmask of the latest syscall.
reason: The fix adds argmasks to all eight fake syscalls, seven of which lacked them before this change, so it cannot be told whether the reported shutdown crash went through the entry this change added.

defect: LoadRelocations2 reads type_table_size from flag_table[0] instead of type_table[0], misparsing the relocation stream.
reason: The fix corrects exactly this copy-paste line in the function this change added.

defect: Execute_Call reads the target with ReadUnchecked_U32 for the bone-matrix check before validating the address; the fix moves the validity check first.
reason: The unchecked read before the validity check already existed before this change, which only changed the address mask to round down to 4 bytes.

defect: For REPLACE_ALPHA_NO the change forces amask = false, but ReplaceAlphaWithStencil also returns NO in clear mode and for stencil-enabled alpha blending without dual-source, where the old code honoured pmska, so alpha writes are wrongly masked.
reason: The fix (#4913) makes REPLACE_ALPHA_NO use the pmska mask again, repairing the case this change added.

defect: The fix only wraps the text when it actually crosses the end of the ring buffer after the color prefix has been written separately.
reason: The crashing code (writing the color prefix first and then unconditionally wrapping) came from the intermediate commits f73c67b and ac59efa; in this change the wrap branch was entered only when the combined line crossed the end, so the check was correct.

defect: Moving the cull setup into the non-clear branch leaves the previous draw's culling enabled during clear-mode draws, so clear primitives can be culled (FF Type-0 shadows).
reason: The fix restores the unconditional cull setup that disables culling in clear mode, which this change removed.

defect: The fix moves the UTF8(const char *) constructor back inline into the header.
reason: Moving the same constructor body between header and source changes no behaviour; it is a build/refactor change.

defect: The fix guards the word measurement with afterIndex <= str_.length() before calling string_view::substr.
reason: u8_nextchar is bounded by the view size, so no path where afterIndex exceeds the length (and substr would throw) is evident; the guard may be defensive, and the other repairs in the fix (ampersand at end in MeasureWidth) predate this change.

defect: Replacing UIShader_Prepare with a texture rebind and a blend state drops its reset of cull, depth test, scissor, stencil and color mask, so the overlay is drawn with the game's leftover GL state and buttons can vanish in non-buffered rendering.
reason: The fix (#6898), after partial patches for cull and scissor, sets up the overlay through UIContext::Begin, restoring the full state reset this change removed.

defect: The fix adds a workaround in Comp_ReplacementFunc that bails out when the original instruction is still the replacement op (old savestates), avoiding infinite recursion.
reason: This change only replaced js.compilerPC reads with an equivalent accessor; the recursion on broken replacements existed independently of it.

defect: The change logs "Trying a different sample rate" where it actually tries the default device; the fix corrects the log text.
reason: Only the wording of a log message is repaired, which is cosmetic and changes no behaviour.

defect: The fix deletes existing decoders before a savestate load recreates them, and drops the redundant resetAudioList.
reason: The leaking load-state code (__sceAudiocodecDoState) did not exist at this change and was added later; by the fix, shutdown already freed decoders, so removing resetAudioList is cleanup.

defect: In this file the fix removes a debug INFO_LOG and commented-out Break() calls and adjusts whitespace.
reason: These are cleanup edits to the new PPC JIT file, not the repair of a wrong result or crash.

defect: __UsbMicInit does not reset the module state (waitingThreads, isNeedInput, numNeedSamples, audio buffer), so after exiting a game to the menu the next game starts with stale waiters and flags.
reason: The fix makes __UsbMicInit reset exactly the globals this change introduced without reinitialising them.

defect: The change calls __IoCompleteAsyncIO in __IoSyncNotify for the host and default timing modes, consuming the IO manager result before the following WaitResult reads it for the synchronous call.
reason: The fix removes exactly the two __IoCompleteAsyncIO calls this change added to __IoSyncNotify.

defect: The non-SSE ToRGB/ToRGBA build the packed colour by multiplying floats by powers of 256 and summing, which can lose accuracy; the fix uses integer shifts.
reason: The same float formula existed in Math3D.cpp before this change, which only moved it inline (the fix message says it was always like this).

defect: Replacing #if defined(_M_ARM64) || defined(_M_ARM) with #if PPSSPP_API(ANY_GL) inverts the condition, so the GE debugger menu item is greyed out on every GL-capable build.
reason: The fix negates exactly this condition to #if !PPSSPP_API(ANY_GL).

defect: The fix adds a first-run "Download audio plugin" button and shrinks the recent-games grid height to make room for it.
reason: The touched VGrid line only gains extra space for a new feature; nothing this change wrote (the recent-list x offset) is repaired.

defect: The fix replaces the automatic push of PluginScreen on first run with a button on the menu screen, so a crashing download cannot block the emulator.
reason: This is a UI redesign; the automatic push already existed before this change (even unconditionally via true ||), and the crash it guards against lies in the download code.

defect: The fix removes the EnableFZ() call from the Blackberry audio thread because flush-to-zero is already on by default there.
reason: The call was redundant rather than wrong, so its removal is a cleanup, not a defect repair.
